description: Bank balance-sheet presentation inspired by the supplied JPM balance-sheet presentation. All user-supplied bank concepts with stated appearance of at least 5% are classified exactly once. Unclassified (liquidity-oriented) presentation; US-GAAP measurement distinctions and supplementary disclosures are retained. Concept placement is provisional and does not imply equivalence or arithmetic.
classification_notes: The supplied list is used as the concept universe; the appearance threshold is user-provided and has not been recomputed.
Issuer/collateral loan and securities breakdowns, foreign-office deposits and regulatory capital metrics without supplied concepts are not invented.
Concept names alone do not determine netting, preferred-stock redemption classification, maturity, dimensions, consolidation scope or signs. Review filing context before production use.
Recognized overfunded pension assets are primary assets. No-par face amounts and liquidation preference per share are supplementary per-share facts, not stock carrying amounts.

metadata_contract.applies_to: All concept-bearing line_item, total and subtotal nodes; structural groups do not carry fact units.
metadata_contract.period_type: Taxonomy periodType, independent of unit_type. A duration rate remains a supplementary fact in this BS profile.
metadata_contract.unit_type: monetary, shares, per_share or percent; percent facts use the XBRL pure unit and require explicit display scaling.
metadata_contract.contra: Boolean identifying intrinsic deduction balances (allowances, accumulated depreciation and treasury stock). False does not prescribe a positive sign; mixed costs/fees, discounts/premiums and other signed adjustments still require context.
metadata_contract.review_reason: Required on every review concept, whether primary or supplementary. Status denotes review workflow, not recognition on the balance sheet.
metadata_contract.node_kind: line_item is a leaf. total/subtotal may have presentation children and require reported concepts; neither implies a calculation.

taxonomy_reference.note: Period and unit metadata verified against the 2026 schema. Historical filings must still use their own taxonomy versions and fact units.
